content: Asteri Godatteteth
Hessafe guye kawo Arxekisisi iza hanqoy irxxidaappe guye Asxiina ooththidayssanne izikka izi bolla kessida awajja qoppides.
He wode kawoza achchan dosettida oosanchchati, «Kawozas lo7o geela7ota koyite.

Heyta lo7o geela7ota ubbata Suusa gimben diza maccassata duussaso ehana mala, kawozi ba haariza dereta ubbaan daannata shuumo; isttika macca ubbatas alaafe gidida kawoza gundula Hegge alaafeteththa garsan detto; istta malay iitontta mala naagetto.
Hessafe guye kawoza ufayssiza geela7oya Asxiini gishshas godatto gidu» gida. He zorezi kawoza ufayssides; istti gida malakka ooththides.
He wode Biniyaame qommofe Qiise naa, Shim7e naa, Ya7ire naa Mardikiyoosa geetettiza Ayhuda dere asaappe issaadey Suusa gimben dees.
Izikka Baabiloone kawo Nabukadanaxoorey di7i efidaytappe Yuhuda kawo Ikoniyaanera Yerusalaameppe di7etti bida asatappe issaa.

Mardikiyoosa aawa ishas Hadeso geetettiza biya dawus; izis aawaynne aaya baynda gishshas izo dichchiday iza. Hanna Astero geetettizaara asateththan gidiin medhan keeha lo7o. Izi aawaynne izi aaya hayqqidaappe guye Mardikiyoosi izo ba naa mala dichchides.
Kawoza azazoynne awajjay kezida wode daro geela7ota efidi Suusa kataman naagiza Hegges immida; Asterokka kawo keeth efidi maccassata naagiza Hegges hadara imettadus.

Naya iza ufayssadus; izikka izo dosides; izikka izis mala lo7eththiza dumma qommo kath heerakka izis immides. Kawoteththa keeththafe doorettida laappun aylleta izis giigsidi izonne izi aylleta daro izan maccassata naagiza doorettidaso efides.
Mardikiyoosi izis kasetidi yootida mala Astera Ayhuda as gididayssa oosikka yootabeekku.
Qasseka Mardikiyoosi Asteri lo7eteththanne izis gidizayssa erana giidi, maccassa keeththa sinththara gallassan gallassan yaanne haa hemettees.

Geela7oti kawozaakko gelanaappe kasetidi issi layth kumeth dhiiketteettes; layththafe koyro usuppun agina kumeth istta bollay liiqi lo7ana mala karbbenne tiyettiza zayte go7etteettes; kaalliza usuppun aginatan dumma dumma shittotanne dumma dumma sinth tiyiza qalameta go7etteettes.
Hessafe guye issi geela7oya kawozaakko geliza wodey gakkiko, ba koyida ay miishshika ekkada maccassati naagetti diza keeththafe kezada kawozaakko gelawus.

Omars gelada kawozara aqidaappe wonteththa gallas harason maccassati naagetti dizaso efeettes. Heen kawoza laggeththotas alaafe gidida kawoza keeththan ooththiza gundula Shaashigaaze aawateththaa garsan naagettawus; kawozi izo dosidi izi sunththan xeygontta aggiko zaara kawozaakko gelukku.

Mardikiyoosi ba naa mala dichchida izas aawaa isha Abi7eele biya Astera kawozaakko geliza taray izo gakkiin maccassati naagetti diza keeththaa alaafe Heggey izis yootidayssafe attiin hara aykkoka oychchabeekku. Astera izo be7iza as ubbaa sinththan ayyotta beettadus.
Arxekisisi kawotida laappunththa layththan, Tebeete geetettiza tammanththa aginan Astero kawo keeth efida.

He wode kawozi hara maccassa ubbaafe Astero aaththi dosides; hara geela7ota ubbaafe bollara iza kawo matan ayyottadusinne dosettadus. Hessa gishshas izi hu7en godatteteththa kallachcha goxxides. Asxiini godatteteththaa izis immides.

Hessafe guye kawozi Asteri bonchcho gishshas ba mokkonnetassinne ba shuumeta ubbaas gita gibira giigsides. He ba7aalezi izi ayssizaso ubbaan bonchchettana mala awajjissides. Imotakka ba kiyateththa mala isttas immides.
Mardikiyoosi Qonccisida Seera
Geela7oti nam7anththo shiiqetti uttidaashe Mardikiyoosi kawo keeththa penge naagishe uttides.
Astera Mardikiyoosi izis yootida mala ba qommonne ba dereza qottadus; iza hessa ooththida gaasoykka Mardikiyoosi kase izo dichchiza wode iza ooththiza mala ha7ikka iza zore ekkashe diza gishshassa.
Mardikiyoosi kawo keeththa penge naagiza olanchchata halaqa nam7ati Gabataynne Tereshay kawoza bolla hanqettidi kawoza wodhanaas duulatida.
Mardikiyoosi istti seeridayssa gakki eridi godatto Asteris yootides; izakka Mardikiyoosappe siyidayssa kawozas qonccisa yootadus.
Yo7oza pilggishin tumu gidi beettides; he nam7u shuumeti kaqetti hayqqana mala istta bolla pirdettides; hessi ubbay kawoza sinththan taarike maxaafan xaafettides.

footnotes.text: Tebeetey nu agina qoodan tisaase woykko xare agina bessees
